verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's payroll offering covers employee payroll: direct deposits, tax filing and pay stubs in one click, plus W-2s in the employee portal. The same payroll page explicitly offers fast payments and simplified 1099 reporting for independent contractors, so both worker types are paid within one platform. missing for 10: explicit documentation that contractors and W-2 employees are paid in the same pay run or workflow, details on contractor onboarding and payment mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration of contractor payments.
